acceptance: The packaged node-side configuration registers x570 and publishes an authenticated HTTP/WebSocket private-link at https://x570.dsh.onlyservice.io.
x570 has an independent domain, socket, token, and state; offline and token-rotation tests do not interrupt zsh.onlyservice.io.

One wildcard DNS/TLS certificate and registry-driven Hub provide atomic add/remove/status, 404 for unknown nodes, 503 for registered offline nodes, renewal verification, and future-node onboarding without per-node certificate or manual Nginx editing.

stories.given: x570 has the fixed DSH runtime and the reusable Hub is configured
stories.goal: Add nodes such as x570 through node-side installation and registration and obtain an independent endpoint
stories.then: https://x570.dsh.onlyservice.io exchanges its private token for a session and serves authenticated HTTP and WebSocket traffic
stories.value: Reach each DSH host through its own private link without bespoke edge work
stories.when: the owner installs the packed dsh-remote bundle, starts the instance service, and registers x570

stories.given: x570 and the existing zsh endpoint are concurrently healthy
stories.goal: Keep each node on an independent domain, socket, token, and state
stories.then: x570 alone returns 503 while offline, recovers to 200, invalidates its old cookie and WebSocket, and zsh remains 200 throughout
stories.value: Operate or recover one node without interrupting other remote instances
stories.when: x570 is taken offline, recovered, and its token is rotated

stories.given: wildcard DNS points to the VPS and the existing Nginx deployment is healthy
stories.goal: Operate one wildcard DNS/TLS and a registry-driven Hub
stories.then: one wildcard certificate and one generated route mount serve the registry, unknown nodes return 404, registered offline nodes return 503, add/remove validate atomically, and renewal dry-run succeeds
stories.value: Add future nodes without per-node certificates or manual Nginx editing
stories.when: the owner applies the Hub and adds an allowlisted instance ID

exact_next_action: Harden and verify the Hub package, deploy wildcard TLS and registry routing to the VPS with rollback receipts, install/register x570, run public HTTP/WebSocket isolation E2E, and bind one deployed subject.
excluded_paths: unrelated VPS Nginx server blocks, containers, DNS records, certificates, and firewall state

receipt.outcome: x570 is installed and registered as an isolated DSH Remote instance at https://x570.dsh.onlyservice.io; wildcard TLS and the registry-driven Hub are deployed with atomic operations, verified renewal and rollback receipt, while zsh.onlyservice.io remained healthy.
